status: Meal weight and CO2e factor are taken from the sources listed below. ESG points per meal is a BARAKAT scoring rule, not an external standard. CO2e is a global-average estimate.

sources.label: Meal weight: 1.2 pounds of food per meal (about 0.54 kg), the convention used by Feeding America and ReFED
CO2e per kg: derived from FAO (2013), Food wastage footprint: about 3.3 Gt CO2e a year for about 1.3 Gt of edible food wasted, roughly 2.5 kg CO2e per kg (global average, excluding land-use change)

notes: Meals are counted as rescued portions. The CO2e figure is a global average for food that is produced and not eaten; the real saving depends on the food. ESG points reward rescued meals and are not a regulated measure. Always show the factor version beside any figure.
